description: Resolve one reference to a CSDB object: a DMC, a PMC, or an ICN (file name or entity name). Returns the file path(s), issue(s) and title. For an ICN, pass "fromPath" of the data module whose DOCTYPE declares the entity to get the declared file and notation.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for data modules by DMC, referenced objects, ACT/CCT/PCT and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

fromPath.description: Data module whose DOCTYPE declares the ICN entity (optional).

icn.description: ICN (entity name or file name) to resolve.

name: resolve_reference
